verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs state you can install and connect MCP servers and use them with local models. A hands-on community report confirms MCP tool use is wired up, though the first experience was rough: the agent got stuck in an infinite loop on a simple web-read task. That is a reliability concern rather than evidence the capability doesn't exist. Missing for 10: detailed docs on MCP configuration (config format, transports, tool permissions), independent evidence of reliable tool-calling, and hands-on corroboration of a smooth MCP workflow.
